extName.message: Locked Site Blocker – Block Websites with a Timer
extName.description: Extension name as shown in the store (max 75 characters).

extDescription.message: Block distracting websites with a timer of 24 hours to 30 days. Until it ends, a block can't be removed, only extended.

appName.description: Short name in the popup header and toolbar tooltip.

dateLocale.description: BCP 47 locale used to format dates in this language.

menuFor.description: $1 is a timer length, e.g. 24 hours.

badgeRemovableIn.description: Badge on a blocked site while its timer runs. $1 is the time left, e.g. 5d 2h.

popupSub.message: Sites stay blocked. Remove one only after its timer ends.

incognitoText.message: Blocks don't apply in Incognito windows.

accessNotice.message: Site access is limited, so marked sites show Chrome's plain block page. To see the countdown, allow the extension on all sites from Chrome's puzzle menu.

footerExtend.message: Timers can be extended, never shortened.

tipDefault.message: Tip: right-click any page → Block this site.

tipShortcut.message: Tip: right-click any page → Block this site. $P1$ opens this popup.
tipShortcut.description: $1 is a keyboard shortcut, e.g. Alt+Shift+L.

emptyState.message: No sites blocked yet — add one above to get started.

badgeEnded.description: Badge on a site whose timer has run out. It is still blocked.

extendOption.description: A choice in the Extend dropdown: $1 a timer length, $2 the day it would end, e.g. 7 days from now · Mon 9 Nov.

quickAria.description: $1 is a site, $2 a timer length.

quickBlock.description: $1 is the site's name, shown in bold.

reviewTitle.description: Title of the review shown before some new blocks. $1 is the site.

reviewWhen.message: You can't remove it before $P1$. After that, it stays blocked until you remove it.
reviewWhen.description: $1 is a date and time, e.g. Tue 3 Nov, 11:40.

reviewNever.message: You can extend the timer, never shorten it.

reviewPath.message: This blocks all of $P1$, not just $P2$.
reviewPath.description: $1 is the site, $2 the page the user typed, e.g. /r/politics.

reviewGoogle.message: This also blocks Gmail, Drive, Docs and Google sign-in.

reviewAmazon.message: This also blocks the AWS console.

reviewConfirm.description: $1 is a timer length, e.g. 24 hours.

undoButton.description: $1 is the number of seconds left to undo a new block.

errUnreachable.message: Couldn't reach the extension. Close this popup and open it again.

errNoResponse.message: The extension didn't respond. Close this popup and open it again.

askText.message: Is the blocker helping you stay focused?

onDate.description: $1 is a short date, e.g. Mon 26 Oct.

rangeSameDay.description: $1 start time, $2 end time, $3 day (today / yesterday / on <date>).

rangeTwoDays.description: $1 start time, $2 its day, $3 end time, $4 its day.

offTitle2.message: The blocker was switched off twice

offTitleN.message: The blocker was switched off $P1$ times

offBody1.message: It was off $P1$$P2$, so your blocked sites could be opened during that time.
offBody1.description: $1 when (spanFrom / spanAround / spanUntil), $2 the length in brackets with a leading space, or nothing.

offBodyN.message: $P1$ off in total — most recently $P2$. Your blocked sites could be opened while it was off.

errInvalid.message: Invalid link. Try something like facebook.com

errPublicSuffix.message: $P1$ is a domain ending shared by many sites. Enter a specific site, like bbc.co.uk.

errLocked.message: Its timer is still running. You can remove this site in $P1$.

errTimerEnded.message: This site's timer has ended — use "Restart timer" instead.

errShorter.message: Pick a longer option: a timer can only be extended, never shortened.

errTimerRunning.message: This site's timer is still running — use "Extend" instead.

errTabGone.message: That tab isn't open any more.

errNotWebsite.message: This page isn't a website that can be blocked.

errUndoLate.message: Too late to undo: a new block can only be undone in its first 30 seconds.

badgeAttention.message: It was switched off for a while. Click to see when.

blkMessage.message: You blocked this for a reason. You can remove it once the timer below runs out.

blkHint.message: You can make the timer longer from the extension at any time. Removing the site becomes possible when the timer ends.

blkEndedAt.description: $1 is when the timer ended, e.g. Sun 1 Nov, 20:15.

blkExpiredMessage.message: The site stays blocked until you remove it.

blkExpiredHint.message: Open Locked Site Blocker to restart the timer or remove the site.

blkRemovedMessage.message: $P1$ was removed from your block list.

blkTriesLabel.description: Heading over how many times the blocked site was tried.

blkTriesSub.description: $1 is today's count, $2 the day counting started, e.g. Tue 27 Oct.

blkTriesSoon.message: A chart of each day appears from $P1$.
blkTriesSoon.description: $1 is the day the daily chart starts showing, e.g. Tue 10 Nov.

blkTriesChart.message: Visits blocked per day, last $P1$ days
blkTriesChart.description: Caption of the daily chart's table, for screen readers. $1 is the number of days.

blkTriesDay.description: Chart tooltip. $1 is a day, $2 that day's count.
